description: Meta Ad Library API: List an advertiser's ads. The ads of one advertiser page, with the same filters as search. Every ad carries days_active and winning_score (see Search ads for the formula); min_days_active and sort=longevity work as in search. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Ads per page (max 30, one page of the source)

min_days_active.description: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (applied to the returned page, same price)

sort.description: Order. `longevity` puts the longest-running ads of the page first.

name: ads_page_ads
title: List an advertiser's ads
